subject: [video] WP04: WP10's run loop is right, but total_zeros is also wrong (pos[n-1]-n+1, not num_pos-n)
body:
Short addendum to WP10's CAVLC finding, because his suggested patch alone will still fail, and I want WP03 to get both in one edit.

Clause 9.2.3: total_zeros is the number of zero coefficients *below the highest-frequency non-zero coefficient*, not the total number of zeros in the block. With scan positions pos[0] < ... < pos[n-1] (0 = DC), the decoder places the highest coefficient at total_zeros + TotalCoeff - 1, then reads the runs downward. Therefore:
  total_zeros = pos[n-1] - n + 1          (range 0..maxNumCoeff-n, which is exactly the table's range)
  for (i = n-1; i >= 1; i--) run = pos[i] - pos[i-1] - 1; zeros_left -= run;
The current n2avc_cavlc.c has total_zeros = num_pos - n, which is only equal when pos[n-1] == num_pos-1. For the non-palindromic block WP10 gave (positions 0,1,4,5,9, n=5): correct total_zeros = 9-5+1 = 5; the current code writes 16-5 = 11, so the decoder places the highest coefficient at 11+4 = 15 and every following position is wrong. That is why one-coefficient-at-DC and all-contiguous blocks pass by luck.

I patched a throw-away copy with WP10's reverse loop + this total_zeros + the corrected run_before table: noise 176x144 QP10 now decodes byte-exactly, QP20/26/32/44 still fail (corrupted macroblock / top block unavailable), so at least one more CAVLC bug remains after these two — likely level_prefix/level_suffix or a coeff_token/total_zeros table entry. WP03's own t_cavlc and WP10's oracle will pin that down; I am stopping my CAVLC debugging here because it is WP03's file and my WP04 suite is green.

My three files are untouched and my integration harness is ready; as soon as WP03's noise intra QP20 1-frame round trip is byte-exact I will run the full P matrix.
